contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (519.48) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (519.48) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (519.48), and is restated at summary line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' and line 5 'Subtotal'
contributions.detail: 2 Schedule A rows sum to 516.00 + 3.48 = 519.48 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the same 519.48 and is NOT summed as an increment — this is the filer's FIRST report of the cycle (line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is a handwritten zero glyph), so period and year-to-date coincide. The balance ladder closes on the same figures: 0 (line 3) + 519.48 (line 4) = 519.48 (line 5); 519.48 - 519.48 (line 6) = the printed line 7 close, a zero glyph.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (519.48) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (519.48) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' (519.48), and restated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row is 519.48 and equals the schedule's printed page subtotal, its printed total, and the cover's Column A. Column B YTD prints the same 519.48 (first report of the cycle) and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. NOTE the coincidence is real and not a transcription slip: the county filing fee of 519.48 is the whole of both sides, funded by a 516.00 party contribution plus 3.48 of the candidate's own money — the same 519.48 filing fee appears on other Utah County 2010 filings in this wave.

in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither Schedule A nor Schedule B on this legacy_colAB blank prints an in-kind column, no row is annotated in-kind, and the p2 Summary Page carries no separate in-kind line. BOTH conventions were tested rather than inherited: monetary-only gives 519.48 on each side and monetary-plus-in-kind gives the identical 519.48 (there is no in-kind amount to add), so both close on Column A.
escalation_note: No arithmetic escalation was needed — both sides closed on three independent printed figures each (page subtotal, schedule total, Column A). Five tight crops at 900 dpi were geometry proofs and are described in the measure_notes.

3.measure_note: legacy_colAB Schedule A, the UNDERLINE form: rowbands.py returns 17 per-column underline rules at a regular 3.93 pitch, and the four segments of each rule ARE the column bands (Date 6.03-17.87, Name of Contributor 19.40-53.59, Mailing Address & Zip 55.18-83.31, Amount 84.84-95.09). THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE, so row N spans [rule N-1, rule N] and row 1 has no rule above it — its band is extrapolated one pitch up from the first detected rule at 19.39, giving [15.46,19.39]. §A1 FIRST-ENTRY CONTROL: that extrapolated band was cropped BEFORE being used and rendered the printed 'Amount' header with the handwritten '516.00' sitting directly on the rule beneath it — i.e. this filer did NOT skip the first ruled line and her first written entry IS band 1. PROOF OF EVERY WRITTEN ROW (there are only two): pct:84.84,15.46,10.25,3.93@p3 rendered '516.00' (recorded 516.00) and pct:84.84,19.39,10.25,3.94@p3 rendered '3.48' (recorded 3.48). A third control crop of band 3 (pct:84.84,23.33,10.25,3.91@p3) rendered an EMPTY cell, confirming the schedule really stops at two rows and the bands are not off by one.

4.measure_note: Same underline grid as p3: 17 rules, pitch 3.93, first rule 19.51, row 1 extrapolated one pitch up to [15.58,19.51]. PROOF OF EVERY WRITTEN ROW (there is only one): pct:84.67,15.58,10.36,3.93@p4 rendered the printed 'Amount' header above the handwritten '519.48' (recorded 519.48), and the control crop of band 2 (pct:84.67,19.51,10.36,3.93@p4) rendered an EMPTY cell — so the single entry is band 1 and nothing below it was missed.
